title: Circadian Deregulation in Multiple Myeloma: BMAL1/CLOCK Expression Patterns and Diagnostic Performance.
authors: Albayrak, Hamide; Ay, Mustafa Ertan; Tombak, Anil; Cevik, Kenan; Ay, Ozlem Izci; Kabasakal, Tuba; Erdal, Mehmet Emin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多发性骨髓瘤中BMAL1/CLOCK昼夜节律基因表达及其诊断价值，仅涉及mRNA表达统计与机器学习分类，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或结构建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Circadian clock disruption has emerged as a relevant axis in cancer; however, the expression patterns and diagnostic relevance of BMAL1 and CLOCK in multiple myeloma (MM) remain insufficiently defined. METHODS: BMAL1 and CLOCK mRNA expression was quantified by RT-qPCR in bone marrow samples from 46 newly diagnosed MM patients and 13 healthy controls. Group comparisons, ROC analyses, multivariate logistic regression, partial correlation, and machine-learning models (logistic regression, random forest, and support-vector machine) with stratified 5-fold cross-validation (including class-weighted sensitivity analysis) were performed. RESULTS: BMAL1 expression was significantly higher in MM than in controls (1.12 +/- 0.33 vs. 0.85 +/- 0.33, p = 0.016; Cohen's d = 0.83), whereas CLOCK showed no significant univariate difference (p > 0.2). BMAL1 demonstrated moderate diagnostic performance (AUC = 0.729), while CLOCK alone showed limited discrimination (AUC = 0.617). Combined analysis modestly improved performance (AUC = 0.756). In multivariate logistic regression, BMAL1 remained a strong independent predictor of MM (OR = 3343.4, p = 0.0046), whereas CLOCK showed an inverse adjusted association (OR = 0.0037, p = 0.019). BMAL1 and CLOCK expression were strongly correlated in MM (rho  approximately  0.80), persisting after adjustment for age, ISS stage, and beta2-microglobulin (partial r = 0.847, p = 2.2 x 10-13). Among classifiers, the random forest achieved the best performance (AUC = 0.832; AUPRC = 0.952). Specificity was limited across classifiers, indicating that these performance estimates are exploratory and require validation in larger cohorts. CONCLUSION: MM is characterized by BMAL1 upregulation within a preserved but imbalanced BMAL1/CLOCK axis rather than uniform shifts across circadian genes. Although diagnostic performance is moderate, consistent signals across statistical and machine-learning approaches support an MM-associated circadian expression pattern warranting further validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：昼夜节律时钟紊乱已成为癌症研究中的一个重要方向；然而，BMAL1和CLOCK在多发性骨髓瘤（MM）中的表达模式及其诊断价值仍未得到充分明确。方法：采用RT-qPCR技术检测了46例新诊断MM患者和13例健康对照者骨髓样本中BMAL1和CLOCK mRNA的表达水平。进行了组间比较、ROC分析、多变量逻辑回归、偏相关分析以及机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林和支持向量机），并采用分层5折交叉验证（包括类别加权敏感性分析）。结果：MM患者中BMAL1表达显著高于对照组（1.12 ± 0.33 vs. 0.85 ± 0.33，p = 0.016；Cohen's d = 0.83），而CLOCK在单变量分析中无显著差异（p > 0.2）。BMAL1显示出中等诊断性能（AUC = 0.729），而单独使用CLOCK的区分能力有限（AUC = 0.617）。联合分析略微提高了性能（AUC = 0.756）。在多变量逻辑回归中，BMAL1仍是MM的强独立预测因子（OR = 3343.4，p = 0.0046），而CLOCK显示出反向调整关联（OR = 0.0037，p = 0.019）。在MM中，BMAL1和CLOCK表达呈强相关（rho ≈ 0.80），在校正年龄、ISS分期和β2-微球蛋白后仍持续存在（偏相关系数r = 0.847，p = 2.2 × 10⁻¹³）。在各分类器中，随机森林表现最佳（AUC = 0.832；AUPRC = 0.952）。各分类器的特异性有限，表明这些性能估计为探索性结果，需在更大规模队列中进行验证。结论：MM的特征在于BMAL1上调，且这种上调发生在保留但失衡的BMAL1/CLOCK轴内，而非昼夜节律基因的均匀变化。尽管诊断性能中等，但统计和机器学习方法的一致信号支持MM相关的昼夜节律表达模式，值得进一步验证。
